name: Curivia
tagline: White-glove logistics infrastructure for the things you make by hand.
positioning: Curivia is the flat-rate logistics platform for makers and collectors who ship singular objects — routed, insured, and handled with documented care.

hero.h1: Logistics infrastructure for objects that cannot be replaced.
hero.sub: One ceramic vase. One restored guitar. One signed first edition. Curivia routes, insures, and hand-documents singular shipments end to end — with a flat rate you set before you pack.

features.title: Custody chain of record
features.description: Every handoff is photographed, timestamped, and signed. Your item carries a verifiable custody ledger from studio door to recipient's hands.

features.title: Carrier arbitration engine
features.description: We benchmark specialist fine-art couriers against freight partners on route, climate, and fragility — then book the one that clears your risk threshold.

features.title: Declared-value insurance
features.description: Set the true worth of a one-of-one piece. Coverage is underwritten per shipment, not capped by generic parcel schedules.

features.title: Condition attestation
features.description: Standardized intake reports document material, dimensions, and pre-existing wear, so damage disputes resolve on evidence, not memory.

testimonials.quote: I used to hold my breath every time a commissioned piece left the studio. Curivia's custody ledger meant the one time a crate was dropped, the claim closed in four days with photos to prove it.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Vollmer

testimonials.quote: We ship restored instruments to buyers who've paid five figures sight unseen. The condition attestation reports have effectively ended post-delivery disputes for us.
testimonials.name: Desmond Achterberg

testimonials.quote: Flat-rate pricing let me quote shipping to collectors before I finish a print run. No more guessing at courier surcharges after the fact.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand-Rusk
